heading: Simple enough for your worst days.
subheading: No setup. No system to learn. Just open it and go.

steps.title: Create your profile.
steps.body: Tell Fleent who you are. Takes 30 seconds - no lengthy setup, no overwhelming options.

image.alt: Fleent task cards stacked for mobile.

steps.title: Add your first task.
steps.body: Type in anything on your mind. One thing. That's all you need to get going.

image.alt: A 'what are you doing today?' input with Fleent adding the task underneath.

steps.title: Let AI break it down.
steps.body: Fleent splits your task into steps so small, starting feels effortless. No thinking required.

image.alt: A task broken into a small, startable checklist.

steps.title: Start the timer - and watch Fleent warm up.
steps.body: Hit focus, and your little buddy comes to life. The longer you work, the warmer they get.

image.alt: A task card with a flame icon as the focus timer runs.
